description: Client-side script for managing advanced settings related to CWMP (TR-069) in a web UI, including data retrieval, UI initialization, and saving configuration.

methods.name: get_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Callback for successful retrieval of object data, copies data to original and modified variables, then initializes layout.

methods.name: get_obj_error_cb
methods.description: Callback for failed data retrieval (empty implementation).

methods.name: get_obj_data
methods.description: Fetches object data using API and specified object list.

methods.name: page_initial
methods.description: Initial page setup, triggers data fetch.

methods.name: cwmp_undo
methods.description: Resets radio button UI elements to default state and reloads data.

methods.name: switch_style
methods.description: Updates UI radio button styles based on selection.

methods.name: layout_init
methods.description: Initializes UI elements with data from MODIFIED_OBJ_DATA.

methods.name: page_save
methods.description: Saves current UI state into data object and triggers save API call.

methods.name: set_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Callback for successful data save, updates original data copy.

methods.name: set_obj_data
methods.description: Sends data object to API for saving, handles string or object input.
